subject: English
passage: If a plant has been extinct for thousands of years, how can scientists learn what size it was? One group of researchers came up with a possible answer. When the researchers examined the fossilized stem of an extinct tree, they found xylem vessels in it. Xylem vessels transport water and nutrients inside plants. Because xylem vessels are sized differently depending on how large the plants they support grow, the researchers hypothesized that they could ______
prompt: Which choice most logically completes the text?

choices.A: show how xylem vessels can be found in fossils belonging to plants from other extinct species.
choices.B: explain why the xylem vessels in the stem were so well preserved.
choices.C: identify the sizes of extinct plants whose fossils lack xylem vessels.
choices.D: determine the size of the tree based on the dimensions of the xylem vessels in the stem.

explanation:
Choice D is the best answer because it most logically completes the text's discussion of a hypothesis by one group of researchers about how to determine the size of a long-extinct plant. The text explains that the researchers found xylem vessels in the fossilized stem of an extinct tree and that xylem vessels are responsible for transporting water and nutrients inside plants. The text also explains that xylem vessels have different sizes depending on how large the plants they support grow. Given this information, it follows that the researchers hypothesized that they could determine the size of the extinct tree by examining the dimensions of the xylem vessels in the stem.

Why B is incorrect:

Choice B is incorrect because the text never suggests that the researchers were seeking to explain why the xylem vessels in the stem were so well preserved. Rather, the text indicates that the researchers were seeking to identify an extinct tree's size, and the text strongly suggests that the researchers hypothesized that they could achieve their goal by examining the dimensions of the xylem vessels in the tree's fossilized stem.
